subject.title: feat: report Pi and OpenCode in guided setup

question: Should guided setup report installed agent harnesses through a new generic plugin-owned setup-observation contract, or should Pi and OpenCode remain explicit core exceptions?
rationale: Both implementations can produce the requested UI, but choosing a permanent integration ownership and plugin API direction is a maintainer architecture decision rather than a safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Use plugin-owned observations
options.body: Add a narrow generic contribution and move Pi/OpenCode probing and explanatory metadata into their owning plugins.

options.title: Accept core exceptions
options.body: Keep the direct core probes and explicitly document Pi and OpenCode as intentional bundled exceptions to the plugin ownership rule.

recommendation.title: Use plugin-owned observations
recommendation.body: Add a narrow generic contribution and move Pi/OpenCode probing and explanatory metadata into their owning plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared guided onboarding surface and are the strongest available history-backed owner for its extension boundary.
